def prime_factors(num):
    if num < 2:
        return []
    factors = []
    i = 2
    while i * i <= num:
        while num % i == 0:
            factors.append(i)
            num //= i
        i += 1
    if num > 1:

    return factors

class GSLMatrix:

        self.rows = rows
        self.cols = cols
        self.data = None
        self._matrix = None
        self._init()

    def _init(self):
        self._matrix = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)()
        libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
        libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
        gsl_matrix_alloc = libgsl.gsl_matrix_alloc
        gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)
        gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
        self._matrix = gsl_matrix_alloc(self.rows, self.cols)
        self.data = np.ctypeslib.as_array(self._matrix, shape=(self.rows, self.cols))

    def free(self):
        libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
        gsl_matrix_free = libgsl.gsl_matrix_free
        gsl_matrix_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
        gsl_matrix_free(self._matrix)

    def __del__(self):
        self.free()

    @staticmethod
    def numpy_to_gsl_matrix(np_array):
        rows, cols = np_array.shape
        gsl_matrix = GSLMatrix(rows, cols)
        gsl_matrix.data[:] = np_array.ravel()[:]
        return gsl_matrix

    @staticmethod
    def gsl_matrix_to_numpy(gsl_matrix):
        return np.ctypeslib.as_array(gsl_matrix._matrix, shape=(gsl_matrix.rows, gsl_matrix.cols))

        self.gsl.gsl_permutation_next.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self.gsl.gsl_permutation_length.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        
        # Define return types
        self.gsl.gsl_permutation_init.restype = None
        self.gsl.gsl_permutation_next.restype = ctypes.c_int
        self.gsl.gsl_permutation_length.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
        
        # Allocate memory for permutation object
        self.perm = ctypes.c_void_p()
        self.gsl.gsl_permutation_init(ctypes.byref(self.perm))
        
    def generate_permutations(self, n):
        permutations = []
        
        # Initialize permutation
        self.gsl.gsl_permutation_init(ctypes.byref(self.perm))

            # Get current permutation length
            length = self.gsl.gsl_permutation_length(ctypes.byref(self.perm))
            
            # Check if we have reached the end

def compute_statistics(N, K, sigma, N_sigma):
    # Load GSL libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    gsl.gsl_ran_gaussian.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_ran_gaussian.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Define C function signature for moving statistics
    gsl.gsl_stats_mad.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_stats_mad.restype = ctypes.c_double

    gsl.gsl_stats_iqr.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_stats_iqr.restype = ctypes.c_double

    gsl.gsl_stats_sn.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_stats_sn.restype = ctypes.c_double

    gsl.gsl_stats_qn.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_stats_qn.restype = ctypes.c_double

    gsl.gsl_stats_sd.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_stats_sd.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Initialize RNG
    gsl.gsl_rng_env_setup()
    rng = ctypes.c_void_p()
    gsl.gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p()
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_default

    # Create vector
    vec = (ctypes.c_double * N)()
    for i in range(N):
        idx = i
        for s in range(len(N_sigma)):
            if idx == N_sigma[s]:
                current_sigma = sigma[s]
                break
        else:
            current_sigma = sigma[-1]
        val = gsl.gsl_ran_gaussian(rng, current_sigma)
        vec[i] = val

    # Compute statistics for each element
    result = []
    for i in range(N):
        start = max(0, i - K + 1)
        end = i + 1
        if end - start < K:
            continue
        sub_vec = vec[start:end]
        mad = gsl.gsl_stats_mad(sub_vec, 1, end - start)
        iqr = gsl.gsl_stats_iqr(sub_vec, 1, end - start)
        sn = gsl.gsl_stats_sn(sub_vec, 1, end - start)
        qn = gsl.gsl_stats_qn(sub_vec, 1, end - start)
        sd = gsl.gsl_stats_sd(sub_vec, 1, end - start)
        result.append((vec[i], mad, iqr, sn, qn, sd))
    return result

        gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.matrix = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc(3, 3, 3)

        gsl.gsl_spm.atrix_set.restype = None
        gsl.gsl_spmatrix_set(self.matrix, row, col, value)

        self.gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int]
        self.gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
        vec = self.gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(ctypes.c_int(size))
        if not vec:
            raise RuntimeError("Failed to allocate GSL vector")
        
        data_np = np.array(data, dtype=np.float64)
        data_ctypes = data_np.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
        self.gsl.gsl_vector_set_data.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
        self.gsl.gsl_vector_set_data(vec, data_ctypes)
        return vec

    def extract_gsl_vector(self, vec, size):
        vec_data = (ctypes.c_double * size)()
        self.gsl.gsl_vector_data.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
        self.gsl.gsl_vector_data.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)
        data_ptr = self.gsl.gsl_vector_data(vec)
        ctypes.memmove(vec_data, data_ptr, size * ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_double))
        return np.ctypeslib.as_array(vec_data, shape=(size,))

    def gsl_filter_impulse_python(self, input_data, t, K):
        if not isinstance(input_data, list) or not all(isinstance(x, (int, float)) for x in input_data):
            raise ValueError("Input data must be a list of numbers")
        if not isinstance(t, (int, float)):

        if not isinstance(K, int) or K <= 0:
            raise ValueError("K must be a positive integer")
        
        size = len(input_data)
        if size < 1:
            raise ValueError("Input data cannot be empty")
        
        # Create GSL vector

        # Allocate workspace
        workspace = self.gsl.gsl_filter_impulse_alloc(ctypes.c_int(K))
        if not workspace:

        # Prepare output vector

        output_data = self.extract_gsl_vector(output_vec, size)

    def __init__(self):
        self.buf = None
        self.size = 0
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0

        self.buf = np.zeros(size, dtype=np.int32)
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0
        self.full = False

    def insert_into_ringbuf(self, values):
        for val in values:
            if not self.full:
                self.buf[self.head] = val
                self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.size
                if self.head == self.tail:
                    self.full = True
            else:
                self.tail = (self.tail + 1) % self.size
                self.buf[self.tail] = val

        if self.full:

        libgsl.gsl_spmatrix_memcpy.restype = ctypes.c_int
        
        self.matrix = libgsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc(self.size1, self.size2, self.size1, self.size2)
        self.alloc = ctypes.c_int(1)

        self.data = np.array(data, dtype=np.int32)
        self.indices = np.array([0]*len(data), dtype=np.int32)
        self.pntrb = np.array([0]*self.size1, dtype=np.int32)
        self.pntn = np.array([0]*self.size1, dtype=np.int32)
        self.ncol = np.array([0]*self.size1, dtype=np.int32)

        self.data = np.array(source.data, dtype=np.int32)
        self.indices = np.array(source.indices, dtype=np.int32)

        self.pntrf = np.array(source.pntrf, dtype=np.int32)
        self.ncol = np.array(source.ncol, dtype=np.int32)

        if self.data is None:
            raise ValueError("Data not initialized")

    def _compare(self, source):
        self._check_data()
        source._check_data()
        
        if np.array_equal(self.data, source.data) and np.array_equal(self.indices, source.indices) and np.array_equal(self.pntrb, source.pntrb) and np.array_equal(self.pntrf, source.pntrf) and np.array_equal(self.ncol, source.ncol):
            print("Success: Data copied correctly")
        else:
            raise ValueError("Data mismatch after copy")
